name: Sendi API – Livraison
author: emmanuel1407

sections.description:
SendiAPI is a unified delivery API for Africa. This plugin integrates SendiAPI with WooCommerce, allowing you to offer delivery with cash on delivery payment.

Official integration for SendiAPI delivery platform.

Features

  • Automatic order submission to SendiAPI
  • Cash on delivery payment
  • Custom checkout fields for delivery information
  • Real-time delivery price calculation
  • Order tracking via shortcode
  • Admin dashboard with statistics
  • Detailed logs for debugging
  • HPOS compatible
  • Multi-commune support

How it works

  1. Customer places an order with delivery option
  2. Order is automatically sent to SendiAPI
  3. A delivery agency is assigned
  4. Customer pays upon delivery

External Services

This plugin connects to the SendiAPI delivery platform to provide delivery services with cash on delivery.

Service: SendiAPI Delivery Platform (https://sendi-api.com)
Usage: The plugin sends order information to SendiAPI to create delivery orders, track deliveries, and manage delivery agencies.

Data sent to SendiAPI:
– Order details (order ID, items total)
– Customer information (name, phone, address, delivery commune)
– Merchant information (store name, phone, email, pickup address)
– Delivery price and agency selection

When data is sent:
– When an order is placed with cash on delivery and the customer selects the SendiAPI delivery method
– When checking delivery status (periodic updates)
– When calculating delivery prices in real-time

Terms of Service: https://sendi-api.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://sendi-api.com/privacy

Privacy

This plugin does not store personal data outside your WordPress installation. Data is transmitted to SendiAPI only for delivery purposes as described in the External Services section.

Support

For support, please visit: https://sendi-api.com/contact

Credits

Developed by SendiAPI – https://sendi-api.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/livraison-api/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Sendi API > Settings and configure your API key
  4. Fill in your merchant information
  5. Save settings and test the connection
sections.faq:
Do I need a SendiAPI account?

Yes, you need to create a free account on SendiAPI to get your API key.

How does cash on delivery work?

The customer pays the delivery driver directly upon delivery.

Which payment methods are supported?

Cash and mobile money (Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money, Wave).
